rules.money: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: account statements, account closures, general bills and payments. Lawyer invoices belong in legal. Property maintenance goes to residence or workshop. Tax-preparation records belong in taxes.
rules.taxes: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: returns, tax forms, and records explicitly gathered for preparing a tax return, including rental income and workshop expenses. An ordinary property bill is not tax preparation just because it includes tax.
rules.residence: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: the Rivermouth rental house, tenants, repairs, property taxes, insurance, and sale. Records explicitly for preparing income tax returns go to taxes.
rules.workshop: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: the Greenhollow workshop building, its repairs, sale, and building photographs. Individual movable objects go to belongings; records explicitly for tax preparation go to taxes.
rules.belongings: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: individual movable possessions or groups of possessions, their identification, valuation, or disposal; photographs of such objects. A workshop building itself belongs in workshop.
rules.history: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: memories, tributes, family photographs, and biographical records. A historical document needed for a current property transaction belongs to the relevant property category.
rules.notes: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: cross-topic research notes and annotated reading. A document whose subject clearly belongs to a specialized destination goes there instead.
rules.legal: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: court filings, property disputes, lawyer correspondence and lawyer invoices. Exclude tax returns and bank statements.
